title: Session placement
summary: A test machine is a QA host reached only through its lease; it is never a launch target. When a Yoke QA mission installs Yoke on a test machine and connects it, that connect registers a Machine with the server it reached, hosted or self-hosted. The walker finds it with `yoke machine list` on that server, launches onto it through that same server with `--machine MACHINE_ID`, and retires it with `yoke machine retire MACHINE_ID --confirm`, together with the test's projects and repositories, as docs/testing-verification/qa-fixture-cleanup.md teaches. The shared QA platform records no connected Machine and walk-end retires nothing.
